changes.title: Boot art first
items: The first picture is ready sooner: the trees and creatures on screen are drawn first, the rest of the island after

changes.title: Packs volcanic
items: Komodo dragons, salamanders and stegosauruses fight as packs now: they take turns, combo their moves and fall back between attacks

changes.title: Packs mangrove
items: Crabs, dragonflies and hydras fight as packs now: they take turns, combo their moves and fall back between attacks

changes.title: Packs jungle
items: Elephants, jaguars, jungle pythons and tigers fight as packs now: they take turns, combo their moves and fall back between attacks

changes.title: Packs hot
items: Sand cats, cheetahs, fennecs and lions fight as packs now: they take turns, combo their moves and fall back between attacks

changes.title: Packs badlands
items: Armadillos, meerkats, rattlesnakes and scorpions fight as packs now: they take turns, combo their moves and fall back between attacks

changes.title: Dark indoors
items: Inside the treehouse's rooms the forest behind is dark: only the house and the Ent's crowns show, which leaves more of the machine free while the island loads
Stepping out onto the Terrace the forest opens out from the doorway in a moment, and closes again as you go back in; through the telescope it fades in
